blocks.text: Filipina actress, host, and former “Pinoy Big Brother: Otso” housemate Hasna Cabral died on Wednesday, Nov. 25, following a stroke that affected brain activity. She was 37. Cabral, who used to be known as Hasna Usman, first gained national recognition in 2019 as the “Ukay Nanay ng Cavite” during her stint on the popular reality show. That defining persona became her most iconic role in the public eye, as viewers admired her grit as a single mother raising two children on the autism spectrum, Basha and Baste.
